svg.title: What's in the kit
svg.desc: The method (rule cards, skills, roles, conventions) can be learned without an agent. A setup wizard writes project instructions (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md). Claude Code uses hooks and cards to steer the flow; Codex, other apps and API-key agents read AGENTS.md and SKILL.md. Both read and write the same vault through the knowledge-base engine (command line, MCP server).
